title: Maps and geography find more hits
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Titles matching maps reach ten snapshot points at least 1.25x as often as other stories.
expect: Share of stories reaching ten points, against all stories of the same months, across 2006 to 2026: at least 1.25x supports; at or below 1.0x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.

check.per_label: stories reaching ten points per story against the same-month average

group_b.label: Average story of the same months ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: Title matching only: the word list is in scripts/film.py and will miss and mis-match some stories.
Archive scores and comment counts for recent stories are low for all stories, so only ratios against the same months are used.
Associations do not show what causes attention.
